paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimations in different token decoding temperature . Right: Influence of token decoding temperature on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how three uncertainty estimation metrics (AU, TU, and EU) vary as a function of token decoding temperature. The x-axis is labeled “Decoding Temperature,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0.0 to 0.8 with regularly spaced tick marks every 0.2 (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). The y-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and shows values from approximately 0.000 up to about 0.175 with evenly spaced tick labels at 0.025 intervals. Three solid lines with circular markers are shown: AU is a red line with circle markers that is near 0.125 at temperature 0.0, rises slightly to around 0.126 at 0.2, dips to about 0.123 at 0.4, increases to roughly 0.141 at 0.6, and reaches about 0.184 at 0.8; TU is a blue line with circle markers that is around 0.126 at 0.0, about 0.128 at 0.2, about 0.124 at 0.4, increases to roughly 0.143 at 0.6, and ends near 0.185 at 0.8; EU is a green line with circle markers that stays close to the bottom of the axis throughout, around roughly 0.002–0.003 across all temperatures, with a small upward shift visible toward 0.6–0.8.
